final String var = eval.substring(varBounds[SUB_START_IDX], varBounds[SUB_END_IDX]);

The first code statement extracts the variable from the expression, and if the variable's value is itself a reference to that same variable, it can lead to infinite recursion when trying to resolve its value. if (val.contains(refVar)) {
    return expr; // return original expression if there is a loop
}
```

This statement detects if the resolved value `val` contains the reference variable `refVar`, indicating a self-referential loop. If such a loop is detected, it returns the original expression instead of attempting to substitute it further, thus preventing infinite recursion and ensuring that the configuration system behaves correctly when multiple references to the same variable exist.
